code_paths.note: Research decoder in tools/ (sni_tunnel.py). The decoders/Python/apps/<Proveedor>/ path is the PLANNED integration path; it is not integrated yet. No catalog decoder exists because the app has no catalog (BYOC client).

connection_authentication.algorithm: HKDF-SHA256 (HMAC-based key derivation) for the v2rc outer layer; ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD for the sealed config; PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (120,000 iters) for the password envelope. No HMAC authenticates a VPN connection.
connection_authentication.note: HKDF-SHA256 is HMAC-based key DERIVATION, not connection authentication. No HMAC or MAC was observed authorizing a VPN connection. No connection-auth handshake was traced or attempted. Status covers the reviewed material only.

limitations: No catalog: SNI Tunnel is a BYOC client (the user brings their own configs).
The v2rc 'SOMBRE' link's inner password envelope was NOT decrypted (password unknown, link expired); only the outer layer was verified.
The device key seed is 'sni-tunnel-device-id-v2|<package>|<ANDROID_ID>'; the ANDROID_ID is device-specific and never stored here.
No .sks file format exists for SNI Tunnel.
network_requirements: cloud relay only (https://snicfg.asnly.net/v1/configs, plain HTTPS); decoders run offline.
